## [0.2.0](https://github.com/semi-column/window-shopper/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0) (2026-11-20)

### ✨ New Features

* add About section to Morphe menu ([79a0647](https://github.com/semi-column/window-shopper/commit/79a0647dca44a2576886cf502688d2507e2f5acf))
* floating apply button, drop Loans tab toggle, rename to Tab bar ([ad6503e](https://github.com/semi-column/window-shopper/commit/ad6503eb4a61fe3e0f4268672486165556b77c88))
* native Morphe menu, account divider and safer defaults ([447f689](https://github.com/semi-column/window-shopper/commit/447f689d2e84e5992043640978d4797732a9f97b))
* settings import/export and About card ([a437236](https://github.com/semi-column/window-shopper/commit/a43723659fc5385437321263cb9dbc0c4d25326c))

patches.name: Block analytics and telemetry
patches.description: Answers Meesho event and SDK logging calls locally, skips the SMS inbox upload worker, and opts out of AppsFlyer, Facebook and Firebase analytics.

patches.name: Customize tab bar
patches.description: Adds settings to pick and reorder up to 5 tab bar tabs, including Account, and to hide Account in the home header.

patches.name: Hide Pay Later secondary price
patches.description: Hides the Pay Later secondary price on listings and the Pay next month banner on product pages without changing the primary price or checkout.

patches.name: Hide Refer and Earn
patches.description: Removes Refer and Earn from the home header and account screen.

patches.name: Hide loan and Pay Later profile entries
patches.description: Removes the three finance entries from the account list without changing repayment or checkout.

patches.name: Hide recommendation trays
patches.description: Removes the Gold Premium Quality, You may also like and related category rows from search, the recently viewed category shelf from home, and stops Similar Products rows in search, category pages and the home feed.

patches.name: Hide reel cards in feeds
patches.description: Removes reel-format catalog cards from discovery feeds while leaving the video tab untouched.

patches.name: Hide sponsored listings and order ads
patches.description: Removes active sponsored product records, two identified My Orders finance banners and the Wishlist Pay Later banner, and disables configured order ads.

patches.name: Product ratings only
patches.description: Removes supplier review summaries and supplier-typed catalog ratings. Missing product ratings stay missing.

patches.name: Sort loaded search results by rating count
patches.description: Adds a button to sort currently loaded search and category products by product rating count.

patches.name: Sort search pages by rating count
patches.description: Sorts each returned search page by product rating count, highest first. Does not globally reorder unloaded pages.
